_comment: 手机端「一台配对桌面的设置」读起来要和桌面一样：设备页列出 权限 / 回复 / 存储 / 模型 / …，
三页各自只装桌面同名页里那几项。原先只有一页「自动化与审批」，三处内容混在一起。

settings-device-home.note: 设备设置首页：权限、回复、存储与模型/提供商/技能/任务并列。

steps.eval: (() => { const text = document.body.innerText; for (const label of ['权限', '回复', '存储', '模型', '提供商', '技能']) if (!text.includes(label)) throw new Error('missing row ' + label); if (text.includes('自动化与审批')) throw new Error('the old combined page is still offered'); return 'device home lists the desktop names'; })()

settings-mobile-permission.note: 手机端「权限」页：只装桌面同名页的那几项。

steps.eval: (() => { const text = document.body.innerText; if (!text.includes('审批模式')) throw new Error('权限 page is missing its rows'); if (text.includes('选项卡')) throw new Error('权限 page carries another page\'s rows'); if (text.includes('归档')) throw new Error('权限 page carries another page\'s rows'); })()

settings-mobile-reply.note: 手机端「回复」页：只装桌面同名页的那几项。

steps.eval: (() => { const text = document.body.innerText; if (!text.includes('选项卡')) throw new Error('回复 page is missing its rows'); if (text.includes('归档')) throw new Error('回复 page carries another page\'s rows'); if (text.includes('闲置天数')) throw new Error('回复 page carries another page\'s rows'); })()

settings-mobile-storage.note: 手机端「存储」页：只装桌面同名页的那几项。

steps.eval: (() => { const text = document.body.innerText; if (!text.includes('闲置天数')) throw new Error('存储 page is missing its rows'); if (text.includes('选项卡')) throw new Error('存储 page carries another page\'s rows'); })()

settings-mobile-skills.note: 手机端「技能」页顶部承接桌面技能页的两个开关：自动升级技能、智能技能推荐。

steps.eval: (() => { const text = document.body.innerText; for (const label of ['自动升级技能', '智能技能推荐']) if (!text.includes(label)) throw new Error('skills page lost ' + label); if (text.includes('自动归档')) throw new Error('skills page carries the storage rows'); })()
